notes: potterybarn.com answers Akamai HTTP 403 'Restricted Access' to this machine, to translate.goog and to WebFetch (Williams-Sonoma geo/bot block); pages were read through the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which renders the WSI SPA. qty is the PLP's own rendered 'N Items' header directly under the H1. Every qty was also cross-checked against the site's Constructor.io search layer (ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<id>, key from window.__INITIAL_STATE__.shop.searchEngineConfig.constructorKey); the two agreed on most categories but Constructor is inflated on some (e.g. Vases 97 vs 83 rendered), so the rendered header was always kept. Category tree taken from Pottery Barn's own landing-page navigation; links use PB's canonical group-id paths. Out of scope per brief and therefore omitted: home fragrance and scented candles, faux botanicals and florals, holiday and gifts, pillows/throws/table linens and other textiles, baskets and storage, kitchen tools and food storage, bath, flatware, ceiling fans, light bulbs, furniture and rugs.
